title: Quote: (about his employees) If they are working in an environment ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: (about his employees) If they are working in an environment where excellence is expected, then they will do excellent work without anything but self-motivation. I'm talking about an environment in which excellence is noticed and respected and is in the culture. If you have that, you don't have to tell people to do excellent work. They understand it from their surroundings.
